name: Polymarket Trading Team
description: Multi-agent sistem untuk prediction market trading di Polymarket — scan, probability analysis, research, dan portfolio management

polymarket-master.description: Master orchestrator — identifikasi edge, koordinasi analisis, output trade decision dengan Kelly sizing

market-scanner.description: Scan universe Polymarket, filter berdasarkan liquidity/timing/kategori, flag potential mispricings

probability-analyst.description: Estimasi true probability via base rates, model aggregation, Bayesian update, dan bias correction

research-agent.description: Deep research per market — primary sources, expert consensus, resolution criteria, evidence synthesis

portfolio-manager.description: Kelly sizing, diversifikasi, position tracking, exit strategy, P&L analytics, drawdown management

analysisFlow.description: Alur dari opportunity discovery ke trade execution

disclaimer: Prediction markets involve risk. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Only trade with capital you can afford to lose.
